targets.old_statement: Inside a roundabout, stay right of the center island; vehicles already circulating have the right of way, and you stop only when it is the only safe way to avoid a collision.

targets.statement: While traveling inside a roundabout, keep right of the center island; vehicles in the roundabout hold the right of way, and you must not stop unless stopping is the only safe way to avoid a collision or other danger.
